anatomy.title: Vocal ligament and vocalis sources · draft
anatomy.body: Vocal ligaments connect the thyroid cartilage to the arytenoid vocal processes. Vocalis lies alongside; the overlying mucosal fold is not a separately validated surface here.
bullets: Unvalidated source subset. Shape, side, attachment footprints and tissue boundaries require specialist review. Conus elasticus, aryepiglotticus and pterygomandibular raphe candidates are withheld, as are the previous pharyngeal raphe and middle constrictors. No complete mucosal layers, airway lumen, laryngeal nerves, swallowing, phonation or operative planes are simulated.
Use Study windows & focuses to preview and open its local study view.
